events.title: LEARN AT LAUNCH | Burnout + Belonging
events.description:
In a world that celebrates grind culture, solo-preneurs and remote workers need to be intentional about meaningfully coping with stress and identifying early signs of burnout. 
Join us for September’s Learn at Launch, where presenter Andie Hines-Lagemann from Elevate Ventures will dive into the science of stress, how to spot the early warning signs of burnout, and why genuine belonging is a core human need and one of the most powerful tools for personal and professional well-being.

events.title: STARTUP MASTERY | Design with the Payer in Mind: Balancing Commercial Traction with Regulatory Timelines
events.description:
Proving your technology works is only half the battle. For early-stage life science, medical device, and digital health startups, the ultimate bottleneck is surviving the long, capital-intensive road between regulatory clearance and real commercial adoption. To build a venture that lasts, founders must design for reimbursement pathways, payer mechanics, and clear monetization strategies from day one. 
This installment of Startup Mastery moves past abstract theory to deliver actionable blueprints

Join us to talk about Ruby, work projects, hack on something, or just get a drink or bite & enjoy the company.

We are mixing it up again and meeting this month at The Ale Emporium Castleton location
8617 Allisonville Rd
Indianapolis, 46250
